name: Anthony Ippolito
bio: Anthony Ippolito (born August 21, 1999) is an American actor mostly known for playing Sylvester Stallone in I Play Rocky (2026).
place: New York City, New York, USA

credits.title: I Play Rocky
credits.overview: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds.

credits.title: Purple Hearts
credits.overview: An aspiring musician agrees to a marriage of convenience with a soon-to-deploy Marine, but a tragedy soon turns their fake relationship all too real.

credits.title: Pixels
credits.overview: Video game experts are recruited by the military to fight 1980s-era video game characters who've attacked New York.

credits.title: Fool's Day
credits.overview: Fool's Day is a dark comedy about a 4th grade class that pull an innocent, April Fool's prank on their teacher...that accidentally kills her.
